title: Sunday · hemlocks from the road
logline: Gully's half-acre from the road, before Wood visits: the hemlocks, the gravel, the ranch house's one lit window, dusk. The strip is very quiet about it a month early.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a gravel drive leaving the road into hemlocks at dusk, a small ranch house among them with one window lit, a flatbed in the drive.

image.prompt: a gravel drive leading from a road into hemlock trees at dusk with a small ranch house among them showing one lit window and a flatbed truck parked, no words

panels.name: Road

panels.composition: Tier 2: the lit window, close, from the road: a kitchen, a figure at a sink, the back of a head.

image.prompt: a lit kitchen window seen from outside at dusk with the back of a woman's head at a sink, no words

panels.name: Window

panels.composition: Tier 3: the hemlocks, forty-one of them, dark, the road going on. Held.

image.prompt: a stand of dark hemlock trees beside a road at dusk, no words

panels.name: Trees

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Gully's house from the road, a month before he visits. One window.
